Facts only from data/product-facts.json and data/product-marketing/*.json; open facts are [[VERIFY: what — team]] with a team from data/team-roles.json. Every heater line carries its controls; competitor lines come only from the frameworks' m3 and battlecards and need Specification and compliance sign-off. Sizing follows templates/calculation-model.md. No prices on these pages: price lists come from Sales operations.

pages.title: Why Stock Bromic
pages.summary: The range, the design and the controls a retail buyer is taking on, at a glance.

sections.h: One Family For Every Outdoor Room
body: Bromic covers every space your customers bring to the counter: electric heaters for ceilings, walls, posts and recesses, the Eclipse pendant with heat and light, Eclipse Smart-Heat® Freestanding, built-in gas, and the wheeled Tungsten Smart-Heat® Freestanding Gas tower on natural gas or propane.

bullets: Tungsten Series II in all black, all white or all graphite, with a Diamond, oval or triangle front.
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric behind a tinted glass-ceramic face, just 2.1 in deep.
Eclipse, a matte black disc with a dimmable 3000K LED ring.
Platinum Gas in black or stainless, behind a ceramic-glass screen.

sections.h: Controls That Sell The Second Item
body: Every Bromic heater is paired with Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls: dimming in 1% steps on Platinum and Tungsten Electric, zones, schedules and timers in the Bromic app, with Alexa, Google Assistant, Control4, Crestron and Lutron where compatible. Wi-Fi and app features need compatible Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls, sold separately.

bullets: A complimentary design service: heater selection, placement and coverage drawings from photos, plans or drawings (bromic.com/design-your-space/, 1-800-301-1293, Mon–Fri 9–4 PT).
Intertek ETL / cETL listed electric ranges.
Up to 3 years of warranty cover on Platinum Electric, Eclipse and Tungsten Series II (3 years on the heater and 7 years on the elements, on Select, Coastal and Classic).

sections.h: Heat You Can Feel, Not See

pages.title: Sizing In 60 Seconds
pages.summary: How many heaters a space needs, worked the way Bromic's sizing tool works.

body: Measure the seating area alone, at 20 ft² a seat with aisles included. Then divide by what one heater covers, adjusted for the roof and the weather:
heaters = area ÷ (coverage × cover factor × climate factor), rounded up.

sections.h: Worked Example: 40 Seats, Partly Covered, Cool
bullets: 40 seats × 20 ft² = 800 ft².

Platinum Electric 4500 W (143 ft²): 800 ÷ (143 × 0.85) = 6.6, so 7 heaters, with Affinity Dimmers at one 4500 W heater a channel – seven channels, for example a 5-channel and a 2-channel Dimmer – and a manual wall switch.
Tungsten Freestanding Gas (215 ft²): 800 ÷ (215 × 0.85) = 4.4, but a freestanding heater serves 4 seats at most, so 40 ÷ 4 = 10 towers, each set at its own knob.

sections.h: When You Don't Know The Site
body: Use partly covered and cool (0.85 combined) and say so, then send the customer's photos or plans to the complimentary design service for a full plan. [[VERIFY: cover and climate factors — Product team]] [[VERIFY: controller capacities — Product team]]

pages.title: Selling On The Floor
pages.summary: The questions customers ask, and factual answers to the comparisons they bring.

head: Question
Answer
rows: Will it work in a breeze?
Radiant infrared warms people and objects directly, so it holds up in light wind.
How fast does it warm up?
Platinum, Tungsten and Eclipse Electric are medium wave infrared: about 30 seconds.
Electric heaters dim with Affinity controls; mounted gas is on or off.
Yes, with compatible Affinity Smart-Heat® Controls, sold separately, for Wi-Fi and the app.
Can it go in a closed room?
No. A space counts as outdoor when at least 30% of its perimeter is permanently open.

head: They say
You can say
rows: Platinum recesses in a 7.1 in cavity with the box supplied and a cooling fan, where Infratech's flush frame needs a five-sided Type X pocket on a flat ceiling.
Tungsten Series II mounts on 3/12 to 12/12 with its adaptor; Infratech's flush frame is "ONLY to be used on a flat non-sloped ceiling".
I can get a heat-and-light pendant for a few hundred dollars.
Those run at 1,500–2,000 W on a remote. Eclipse delivers 2,900 W in three settings, hard-wired and IP54, with app control.
Tungsten Gas comes with its wall bracket and runs on 110 V, so there is no 24 VAC transformer to add.

body: Use these lines as written and never run down another brand. Where a competitor leads, such as Infratech's eight colours, say so.

sections.h: Getting It Right The First Time
bullets: Installation by a licensed electrician / gas fitter to local code.
Electric heaters follow NFPA 70 (NEC): wall mounts at least 72 in above the floor, ceiling mounts at least 96 in, varying with output.
Gas heaters follow ANSI Z223.1/NFPA 54 and mount at least 96 in above the floor.
Check every install with the local building authority.
